svg.text: ENTERPRISE GPU CLUSTER POWER CAPPING, PHASE-AWARE DVFS & RACK DENSITY
Phase-Aware Power Capping (600W Prefill / 450W Decode) Packs +33% GPUs/Rack & Saves 36.2% TCO
256x H100 Cluster in 32kW Racks: Tier 1 Uncapped 700W (24 GPUs/Rack, $185K/mo) vs. Tier 2 Static 400W vs. Tier 4 Phase-Aware DVFS (32 GPUs/Rack, $118K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Cubic Watt Waste & Stranded Racks
1. Uncapped 700W Nameplate TDP (Tier 1: Only 24 GPUs / 32kW Rack):
• The top 200W (`500W -> 700W`) on the cubic V²f curve buys <1%
decode speed (HBM-bound!) while stranding 25% of rack slots
2. Blind Static 400W Cap Across All Nodes (Tier 2: 74.5% Goodput):
• Starves compute-bound long-context Prefill nodes (+32% TTFT lag)
3. Unguarded Rack Overbooking (Tier 3: 4.2% PDU Breaker Trips):
• Synchronized prefill bursts trip 32kW rack breakers without
sub-second hardware power clamping
Production Failure Impact (256x H100 GPUs / 32kW Racks):
• Rack GPU Density: Capped at 24 GPUs (3 servers) per 32kW rack
• Thermal Throttling Tail Spikes: 6.8% (Tier 1) | 25.5% SLA Miss (Tier 2)
• Monthly Colocation Racks + Electricity TCO: $185,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Phase-Aware DVFS + DCGM/PDU Feedback Clamp
1. Exploit Memory-Bound Decode Physics (`450W / 1350MHz` SM Lock):
• Decode is 100% HBM3-bandwidth bound; locking SM clock to 1350MHz
cuts Decode GPU power by 34% with <1.2% impact on TPOT!
2. Compute-Bound Prefill Sweet-Spot Cap (`600W` vs `700W`):
• Trims top 100W voltage spike while preserving 98.8% SLO goodput
3. +33.3% GPUs per Rack (`32 GPUs/Rack`) + DCGM/PDU Hardware Clamp:
• Fits 4 servers (32 GPUs) per 32kW rack (8 racks instead of 11!)
with 100ms NVML power step-down if rack PDU exceeds 90% load
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Rack Density: 32 GPUs/Rack (+33.3%) | Cluster Power: -28.0%
• SLO Goodput Retention: 98.8% (Zero thermal throttling spikes!)
• Monthly Rack + Power TCO: $118,000 / mo (-36.2% = $804K/yr saved)
